main.description: The categories posts on skiddle.id belong to, in the order the site shows them. One record, key 'self'. A post names its category by id (id.skiddle.post's category).

id.description: Lower case letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. 'homelab'. Its page is /topics/<id>/, and posts name it by this, so it shouldn't change once posts use it.

label.description: As the site shows it, e.g. 'Infra & delivery'. Can change any time.

description.description: A line about it, on its page.
